strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% maɖonu
strings.seo.why[0].text: Ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me mele o, kredit karta mele o, nɔnɔmeteƒe ɖeke mele wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo ŋu o.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me mele o
strings.seo.why[1].text: Akonta aɖeke mele be yeawɔ o: ʋu axa la, gblo wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖe eme, evɔ.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo nye tɔwò tututu
strings.seo.why[2].text: Wozãe, eye wotu wo ɖa enumake. Míedzra wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo alo nyawo ɖo o.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Nɔnɔme katã
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, nɔnɔmetatawo, EPUB… tso kompiuta alo fon me.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ɛɛ. Dɔwɔnu ɖesiaɖe nye maɖonu, nɔnɔmeteƒe meli o eye nuɖoɖo aɖeke mele ɣaɣla o. Womibia kredit karta kpɔ gbeɖe o.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Ao. Ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me mele o, email adrɛs mele o: èzã dɔwɔnuwo enumake.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Ao. Wozã wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo na dɔ si nèbia ko, eye wotu wo ɖa. Ame aɖeke melé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu o eye wometsɔ wo na ame bubu o.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ɛɛ. Pdff wɔ dɔ le fon, tablɛt alo kompiuta ɖesiaɖe ƒe browser me (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), eye hã melé dɔ ɖe eŋu be yeatsɔ adze to o.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, nɔnɔmetatawo (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML kple bubuwo.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Èate ŋu awɔ nuŋɔŋlɔ {files} ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me, eye axa siwo tso eme ate ŋu aɖo axa {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Nɔnɔme ɣaɣlawo
strings.privacy.description: Aleke pdff léke wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo: akonta mele o, nuŋɔŋlɔ meɖo o, ŋunya kple nyatoƒe mele o.
strings.privacy.intro: Wotu pdff be wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo nanye tɔwò. Afii la, le gbe tsɔtsɔme me, nye nusi dzɔ ne èzãe.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Wotsɔ ŋɔŋlɔ siwo wode ŋgɔ (HTTPS) dɔ wo ɖo, wozã wo, eye wotu wo ɖa enumake ne ewɔvɔ. Nuŋɔŋlɔ gãwo toa teƒe kpui aɖe ne ŋkɔ maɖinuwo le kple wotu wo ɖa ne dɔwɔwɔ vɔ; dzadzraɖo si tso eɖokui si tutuna nusiwo susɔ le gaƒoƒo 24 megbe.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akonta mele o, nya ŋutɔŋutɔ mele o
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: Pdff mebia ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me, email adrɛs alo kredit karta o. Womelé ŋku ɖe wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo ŋu o, wometsɔ wo wɔ dɔ aɖeke o, wometsɔ wo na ame bubu o eye wometsɔ wo sɔŋ zã aɖe le nuxlẽnuwo me o.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Nuxlẽnuwo ŋuti dzodzro
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Míexlẽ trɔtrɔwo bɔbɔe eye cookie mele o (Vercel Web Analytics) be míanya dɔwɔnu siwo ñoŋu. Ŋunya mele o, dodokpɔ mele o.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookie
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie ɖeka ko si ŋu wosɔ hã le: eɖo ŋku gbe si nètia dzi.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Tefemetsɔtsɔ
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel tsɔ saɖe gã la ɖo le Paris; Word, Excel kple PowerPoint trɔtrɔwo la le Render si le Frankfurt. Dɔwɔla siawo léke nuŋɔŋlɔwo na trɔtrɔɣi ko.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kpɔkpɔ
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Biabia alo gbedasi? Kpɔ mí le dɔwɔnu axa dzi:

strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Ƒu PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint kple nɔnɔmetata nuŋɔŋlɔwo ƒu ƒu zu PDF ɖeka, le ɖoɖo si nèdi me. Maɖonu, ŋɔŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me mele o, nɔnɔmeteƒe mele o, wotu nuŋɔŋlɔwo ɖa enumake.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Ðo wò nuŋɔŋlɔwo katã ɖe ɖeka me: pdff xɔ PDF hã gake enɔ Word nuŋɔŋlɔwo, Excel kpewo, nuxlẽnuwo kple nɔnɔmetatawo ŋu, eye wòfu wo ƒu ƒu zu PDF kɔkɔe ɖeka kple dzesi ɖeka le nuŋɔŋlɔ ɖesiaɖe ŋu.
